prompt: As of August 3rd 2024, how many countries are full members of the council that oversees the sport that Henry Simonds plays?
answer: As of August 3, 2024, the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI)—the governing body for BMX—had **197 full-member national federations (countries)**.
